The game started beeping when I find a pair. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Verification passed: 138 unit and static tests, plus all 76 browser tests, including the expanded silence journey. The changed files pass formatting. The repository-wide formatting check still reports 13 unrelated files.
